subject.title: [Bug] Race condition in approval-classifier.ts when tokenization exceeds max tokens

question: Should ACP/security ownership request a private protocol-level proof before closing this report as non-reproducible?
rationale: Current OpenClaw source contradicts the described asynchronous tokenization race, but a security-boundary close requires confidence in the upstream ACP callback and stream-ordering contract that source inspection alone has not fully established.

options.title: Request private proof
options.body: Ask for exact ACP frames, versions, timing, and a minimal proof of execution before approval, then close if the reporter cannot reproduce against current main.

options.title: Close as non-reproducible
options.body: Treat the mismatch with the synchronous current-main path and absence of reproduction evidence as sufficient to close now.

options.title: Escalate privately
options.body: Open or request a private security advisory immediately if maintainers can independently reproduce any pre-approval execution path.

recommendation.title: Request private proof
recommendation.body: Ask for exact ACP frames, versions, timing, and a minimal proof of execution before approval, then close if the reporter cannot reproduce against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is most directly connected to the current semantic approval classifier and its focused regression coverage.
